Script.name: RainbowChat_Script
Script.script:
RainbowChat = RainbowChat or {}
local DEFAULT_ENABLED = true local DEFAULT_MODE = "rainbow"
-- Hue order for the cycling styles. local RAINBOW_PALETTE = { "@r", "@R", "@y", "@Y", "@g", "@G", "@c", "@C", "@b", "@B", "@m", "@M", }
local BRIGHT_PALETTE = { "@R", "@Y", "@G", "@C", "@B", "@M" } local DARK_PALETTE = { "@r", "@y", "@g", "@c", "@b", "@m" }
-- Approximate perceived luminance, darkest to lightest. The reverse is -- used by fadedown. These twelve colors deliberately omit white and gray. local FADEUP_PALETTE = { "@b", "@B", "@r", "@m", "@R", "@M", "@g", "@c", "@y", "@G", "@C", "@Y", }
local BASE_MODES = { "rainbow", "words", "bright", "dark", "fadeup", "fadedown", }
local VALID_MODES = { rainbow = true, words = true, bright = true, dark = true, fadeup = true, fadedown = true, random = true, }
local AARD_COLOR_CODES = { b = true, B = true, r = true, R = true, g = true, G = true, y = true, Y = true, c = true, C = true, m = true, M = true, w = true, W = true, D = true, }
-- Mudlet color names used to preview Aardwolf's dark/bright color pairs in -- local help output. Outgoing chat still uses the original @ color codes. local AARD_TO_MUDLET_COLOR = { b = "ansi_blue", B = "ansi_light_blue", r = "ansi_red", R = "ansi_light_red", g = "ansi_green", G = "ansi_light_green", y = "ansi_yellow", Y = "ansi_light_yellow", c = "ansi_cyan", C = "ansi_light_cyan", m = "ansi_magenta", M = "ansi_light_magenta", w = "ansi_white", W = "white", D = "ansi_light_black", }
local function trim(value) return (tostring(value or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")) end
local function note(message) local text = "[Rainbow] " .. tostring(message or "") .. "\n" if type(cecho) == "function" then cecho("<cyan>" .. text) elseif type(echo) == "function" then echo(text) end end
local function persistenceDirectory() local home = "." if type(getMudletHomeDir) == "function" then home = getMudletHomeDir() end
local directory = home .. "/persistence" if type(mkdir) == "function" then pcall(mkdir, directory) end if type(lfs) == "table" and type(lfs.mkdir) == "function" then pcall(lfs.mkdir, directory) end return directory end
local STATE_FILE = persistenceDirectory() .. "/rainbow_chat_state.lua"
local function loadState() RainbowChat.state = { enabled = DEFAULT_ENABLED, mode = DEFAULT_MODE, }
local ok, saved = pcall(dofile, STATE_FILE) if not ok or type(saved) ~= "table" then return end
if type(saved.enabled) == "boolean" then RainbowChat.state.enabled = saved.enabled end
local mode = tostring(saved.mode or ""):lower() if VALID_MODES[mode] then RainbowChat.state.mode = mode end end
local function saveState() local file, openError = io.open(STATE_FILE, "w") if not file then note("Could not save settings: " .. tostring(openError or "unknown error")) return false end
file:write(string.format( "return { enabled = %s, mode = %q }\n", tostring(RainbowChat.state.enabled == true), RainbowChat.state.mode )) file:close() return true end
local function utf8CharacterLength(firstByte) if not firstByte or firstByte < 0x80 then return 1 end if firstByte < 0xE0 then return 2 end if firstByte < 0xF0 then return 3 end if firstByte < 0xF8 then return 4 end return 1 end
-- Break the message into visible UTF-8 characters. Existing Aardwolf color -- tags are removed because this addon replaces them. @@ remains one visible -- literal-at token so generated tags never split it apart. local function tokenize(message) local tokens = {} local index = 1
while index <= #message do local first = message:sub(index, index) local second = message:sub(index + 1, index + 1)
if first == "@" and second == "@" then tokens[#tokens + 1] = { text = "@@", space = false } index = index + 2 elseif first == "@" and AARD_COLOR_CODES[second] then index = index + 2 else local length = utf8CharacterLength(message:byte(index)) local character = message:sub(index, index + length - 1) tokens[#tokens + 1] = { text = character, space = character:match("^%s$") ~= nil, } index = index + length end end
return tokens end
local function visibleCount(tokens) local count = 0 for _, token in ipairs(tokens) do if not token.space then count = count + 1 end end return count end
local function colorCharacters(tokens, palette) local output = {} local position = 0
for _, token in ipairs(tokens) do if token.space then output[#output + 1] = token.text else position = position + 1 local paletteIndex = ((position - 1) % #palette) + 1 output[#output + 1] = palette[paletteIndex] output[#output + 1] = token.text end end
return table.concat(output) end
local function colorWords(tokens, palette) local output = {} local word = 0 local atWordStart = true
for _, token in ipairs(tokens) do if token.space then output[#output + 1] = token.text atWordStart = true else if atWordStart then word = word + 1 local paletteIndex = ((word - 1) % #palette) + 1 output[#output + 1] = palette[paletteIndex] atWordStart = false end output[#output + 1] = token.text end end
return table.concat(output) end
local function reversedCopy(source) local result = {} for index = #source, 1, -1 do result[#result + 1] = source[index] end return result end
local function fadePaletteIndex(position, count, paletteSize) if count <= 1 then return 1 end
-- Short messages still span the complete dark/light range. At twelve -- characters all twelve colors are used; at twenty-four each is used twice. if count <= paletteSize then return math.floor(((position - 1) * (paletteSize - 1)) / (count - 1)) + 1 end return math.floor(((position - 1) * paletteSize) / count) + 1 end
local function colorFade(tokens, palette) local output = {} local count = visibleCount(tokens) local position = 0 local lastPaletteIndex = nil
for _, token in ipairs(tokens) do if token.space then output[#output + 1] = token.text else position = position + 1 local paletteIndex = fadePaletteIndex(position, count, #palette) if paletteIndex ~= lastPaletteIndex then output[#output + 1] = palette[paletteIndex] lastPaletteIndex = paletteIndex end output[#output + 1] = token.text end end
return table.concat(output) end
local function nextRandomIndex(maximum) if not RainbowChat.randomState then local clockPart = math.floor((os.clock() or 0) * 1000000) RainbowChat.randomState = ((os.time() + clockPart) % 2147483646) + 1 end RainbowChat.randomState = (RainbowChat.randomState * 48271) % 2147483647 return (RainbowChat.randomState % maximum) + 1 end
local function randomMode() local selected = BASE_MODES[nextRandomIndex(#BASE_MODES)]
-- Avoid choosing the same random style for two consecutive messages. if #BASE_MODES > 1 and selected == RainbowChat.lastRandomMode then local oldIndex = 1 for index, mode in ipairs(BASE_MODES) do if mode == selected then oldIndex = index break end end selected = BASE_MODES[(oldIndex % #BASE_MODES) + 1] end
RainbowChat.lastRandomMode = selected return selected end
function RainbowChat.colorize(message, requestedMode) local mode = tostring(requestedMode or RainbowChat.state.mode or DEFAULT_MODE):lower() if mode == "random" then mode = randomMode() end if not VALID_MODES[mode] or mode == "random" then mode = DEFAULT_MODE end
local tokens = tokenize(tostring(message or "")) if mode == "words" then return colorWords(tokens, RAINBOW_PALETTE), mode elseif mode == "bright" then return colorCharacters(tokens, BRIGHT_PALETTE), mode elseif mode == "dark" then return colorCharacters(tokens, DARK_PALETTE), mode elseif mode == "fadeup" then return colorFade(tokens, FADEUP_PALETTE), mode elseif mode == "fadedown" then return colorFade(tokens, reversedCopy(FADEUP_PALETTE)), mode end
return colorCharacters(tokens, RAINBOW_PALETTE), "rainbow" end
local function sendChat(prefix, message) local outgoing = tostring(message or "") if RainbowChat.state.enabled then outgoing = RainbowChat.colorize(outgoing, RainbowChat.state.mode) end send(prefix .. " " .. outgoing, false) end
function RainbowChat.handleChannel(commandName, message) sendChat(tostring(commandName or ""), message) end
function RainbowChat.handleTell(commandName, recipient, message) local prefix = tostring(commandName or "tell") .. " " .. tostring(recipient or "") sendChat(prefix, message) end
local function showStatus() note(string.format( "Status: %s | Mode: %s", RainbowChat.state.enabled and "ON" or "OFF", RainbowChat.state.mode )) end
local function mudletPreview(message, mode) local colored, selectedMode = RainbowChat.colorize(message, mode) local rendered = colored:gsub("@([%a])", function(code) local color = AARD_TO_MUDLET_COLOR[code] return color and ("<" .. color .. ">") or ("@" .. code) end) return rendered, selectedMode end
local function showHelp() note("Automatic Aardwolf chat gradients") note("rainbow on|off|toggle - enable, disable, or toggle automatic coloring") note("rainbow mode <name> - select a coloring style") note("rainbow status - show the current settings") note("rainbow raw <complete command> - send one command without coloring") note("Modes: " .. table.concat(BASE_MODES, ", ") .. ", random") note("Mode examples:") for _, mode in ipairs(BASE_MODES) do local preview = mudletPreview("Rainbow chat example", mode) note(string.format(" %-8s - %s", mode, preview)) end local previousRandomState = RainbowChat.randomState local previousLastRandomMode = RainbowChat.lastRandomMode local randomPreview, selectedMode = mudletPreview("Rainbow chat example", "random") RainbowChat.randomState = previousRandomState RainbowChat.lastRandomMode = previousLastRandomMode note(string.format(" %-8s - %s (picked %s this time)", "random", randomPreview, selectedMode)) note("Watched: clan, cla, say, gt, gtell, tell, reply") showStatus() end
function RainbowChat.command(arguments) local input = trim(arguments) if input == "" or input:lower() == "help" then showHelp() return end
local action, rest = input:match("^(%S+)%s*(.-)$") action = tostring(action or ""):lower() rest = trim(rest)
if action == "on" or action == "off" then RainbowChat.state.enabled = (action == "on") saveState() note("Automatic coloring is now " .. (RainbowChat.state.enabled and "ON." or "OFF.")) return end
if action == "toggle" then RainbowChat.state.enabled = not RainbowChat.state.enabled saveState() note("Automatic coloring is now " .. (RainbowChat.state.enabled and "ON." or "OFF.")) return end
if action == "mode" then local mode = rest:lower() if mode == "" then note("Current mode: " .. RainbowChat.state.mode) elseif VALID_MODES[mode] then RainbowChat.state.mode = mode saveState() note("Mode set to " .. mode .. ".") else note("Unknown mode '" .. rest .. "'. Choose: " .. table.concat(BASE_MODES, ", ") .. ", random") end return end
if action == "status" then showStatus() return end
if action == "raw" then if rest == "" then note("Usage: rainbow raw <complete command>") else send(rest, false) end return end
note("Unknown option. Type 'rainbow help'.") end
loadState()
